provenance.method: Reviewed Healthdirect Australia ADHD diagnosis information and state/territory prescribing caveat on 2026-09-05.

name: Healthdirect Australia — ADHD
description: Australian national health information about ADHD, assessment, diagnosis and specialist roles.
intended_use: National orientation for ADHD assessment in Australia while keeping state/territory implementation and prescribing rules separate.
audience_or_context: Australia; national public health information. State and territory rules differ for ADHD medicine prescribing and local service access.
limitations: Healthdirect orientation does not create uniform state/territory assessment access.
Diagnosis is separate from medication prescribing; ND Oracle does not advise medicine or dose.
cost_or_access_notes: Free public information; specialist and assessment costs/access vary.
